limits.description: Hard cap applied uniformly to every VouchMorph-initiated money movement in this country — swaps, cashouts, card hooks, activations. Not an institution-specific limit (those live in participants.yaml); this is VouchMorph's own risk ceiling.

IDENTITY_HOLD.description: Fh -- hold-time fee (swap levy), earned the instant a real hold exists at the source institution for a swap-to-identity. Always applied: charged whether the client claims in full, claims part, claims nothing, or the hold expires untouched. Purpose-independent by design -- computed at hold placement, before the client has chosen CASHOUT vs DEPOSIT, so it cannot vary by a purpose that isn't known yet. Client decision (2026-09-15): Fh = the swap levy only, identical for CASHOUT and DEPOSIT -- no separate 'hold fee' line item. F1 equals F7 here (the entire hold-time charge IS the levy); the source/destination institutions' own share of a swap's economics is earned later, at delivery, via CASHOUT/DEPOSIT's own F1/F7 (see those blocks) -- this block does not double-charge on top of that.

F1.description: Total hold-time fee (Fh) -- equals the swap levy below. Read as calculateFees()'s 'total_fee' and stored in identity_swap_holds.metadata.hold_fee.total_fee by storeIdentityHold(); consumed later by cancelExpiredIdentitySwaps() on expiry.

F7.description: VouchMorph swap levy (internal fee, owned and retained by VouchMorph -- NOT a government-mandated levy, despite the name). Identical amount to F1 above by design for this product.

distribution.description: F1 - F7 = 0 for this product -- Fh is 100% VouchMorph's levy at hold time, nothing split to source/destination here. Source and destination institutions earn their share later, at delivery, from CASHOUT/DEPOSIT's own distribution.

example_calculation.T_held: any amount -- Fh is flat, not a percentage of T

CASHOUT.description: Cash-out fee P10, every channel (ATM, voucher, agent). Hold stage: levy + source 13%; code issued: destination 10% of its 50%; cash dispensed: destination 90% of its 50% + VouchMorph 35%; settlement: 2%.

F7.description: VouchMorph swap levy (internal fee, owned and retained by VouchMorph -- NOT a government-mandated levy, despite the name)

multi_source.description: Multi-source (2026-09-22): N sources, pool = F1 - F7. VouchMorph: F7 levy x N + 35% x pool (one cut). Each source: 13% x pool (a full cut each). Destination: 50% x pool + 30% of that 50% x (N-1) (cash-outs: 10% at code, 90% at cash dispensed, extra included). Settlement: 2% x pool per settling source. One source = exactly F1. No fee cap (removed 2026-09-22). Replaces the retired F8 +P1.

distribution.description: Section 23 Rev. 2: Swap Levy (F7) first, then the distributable amount F1 - F7 splits 13% source (hold placement and verification), 2% settlement fee (whoever performs settlement; carved from the source's 15%), 35% VouchMorph, 50% destination. Every fee event is recorded per institution in fee_ledger.

destination_split.description: Section 23 Rev. 2 (2026-09-21): the destination's 50% is earned in two portions - 10% when the redemption code is issued, 90% when cash is dispensed. (Replaces the 2026-09-15 0/100 setting.)

earnings_rules.description: Generate code fee is 0% as of 2026-09-15 -- nothing is earned at generation. Full destination share is earned only after successful cashout redemption.

retry_rules.description: Retries charge only the generate code fee

swap_on_swap.description: First retry: VouchMorph pays the generate code fee from platform share

example_calculation.note: F7 levy above is CASHOUT's own distributable-pool levy, separate from IDENTITY_HOLD's Fh (also 1.00) charged earlier at hold placement -- see the IDENTITY_HOLD block.

F1.description: One-time card activation fee, paid in full to VouchMorph

switch_routing.description: Charged only when a swap could not settle DIRECT and had to route through the national switch. Not charged on DIRECT-mode swaps.
switch_routing.amount_note: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the actual per-transaction tariff from your switch operator agreement. Change amount_type to 'percentage' + 'rate' if the switch charges a % of Amount_1 instead of a flat fee.
switch_routing.deduction_note: F23 is NOT split 50/50 flat. It is allocated between source and destination in proportion to their normal revenue_split percentages for this swap type (e.g. DEPOSIT: source=15%, destination=50% of the pool → source absorbs 15/65 of F23, destination absorbs 50/65 of F23). Platform's share is never reduced by F23.
switch_routing.settlement_description: F23 is computed and recorded on every switch-routed transaction at swap time (so each institution's true net share is visible immediately in fee_calculation_details), but no separate cash movement happens per swap. VouchMorph accrues the F23 liability per institution, then nets and settles/invoices the switch operator in a single batch at each calendar month end — consistent with standard EFT/RTC-style clearing (gross recording, netted deferred settlement) rather than per-transaction gross settlement.

F7.name: Swap Levy
F7.description: VouchMorph's own internal swap levy. NOT a government-mandated fee -- despite the name 'levy', this is retained by VouchMorph, not remitted to any regulator. (Confirmed 2026-08-05; master fee_types.php registry previously said owner=REGULATORY -- that file needs the same correction, see fee_types_CORRECTED.php.)

F8.name: Multi-Source Fee
F8.description: Extra fee per additional source account beyond the first, in a multi-source swap

F10.name: Retry Fee
F10.description: Reduced fee charged on a retried swap attempt (generate-code fee only)

F23.name: National Switch Fee
F23.description: Fee charged by the national switch when a swap could not settle DIRECT. See switch_routing section above for allocation rules.
